title: Cyan: receiver reachability and closing alignment

rounds.label: Approach
rounds.diagnosis: The paths ran out of joint reserve or missed the pose.
rounds.change: Move the held piece to a shared workspace, relative to the observed board.
rounds.outcome: Public-geometry rehearsal found screened donor and receiver routes.

rounds.label: Close
rounds.attempt: The new approach reached the piece, but closing was refused.
rounds.diagnosis: The selected finger would penetrate too far.
rounds.change: Reobserve the held piece and recenter the receiving jaw before closing.
rounds.outcome: The next rehearsal passed approach, dual hold, donor withdrawal, and receiver hold.

rounds.label: Verify
rounds.attempt: Repeat the complete transfer in the joined sequence.
rounds.outcome: The continuous twelve-piece run passed all four transfer windows, with an independently verified fresh receiver RGB binding.
